baslik: A Software Glitch Shut Off the Engines Too Early

sahneler.metin: A NASA lander went silent as it descended to Mars.
It most likely crashed into the surface and was never heard from again.
The likely cause was a false signal.
When the legs unfolded, the jolt tripped the touchdown sensors.
High above the ground, it decided it had landed and cut the engines.
The lander fell the rest of the way.
Landing software is now tested end to end with real sensor behaviour.

aciklama:
Mars Polar Lander went silent during landing on Mars. The cause: software treating spurious touchdown-sensor signals from leg deployment as landing, cutting the engines.

#shorts #engineering #software
